rationale: The portfolio already holds an open long position in ADMA representing 6.0% of buying power, which is already larger than any other individual commitment in the account. With price extended at 97.2% of today's range ($13.27 vs $13.31 high) against a severely weak broader market (SPY -2.83%, VIXY +16.84%), adding further long exposure here introduces unnecessary concentration risk near the highs, while shorting directly opposes strong relative strength (7.56x relative volume following an earnings beat) and our existing position.
